description: Diagnose and reverse-engineer obsolete or damaged parts on vintage and track-prepped vehicles, then design, machine, and fabricate custom brackets, mounts, and structural reinforcements to fit aftermarket components onto OEM chassis.

Designed code-compliant structural supports and scaffolding for food production machinery, using facility assessments and SolidWorks FEA to boost baking tray stacking efficiency by 30% while integrating ergonomic principles to reduce worker fatigue.
Designed fixtures for manufacturing precision laser optics to 100-micron accuracy, managing design revisions through Oracle Agile and presenting designs to cross-functional teams and clients.

Engineered robotic manufacturing cells and custom tooling for FANUC arms, developing robot motion paths and PLC/robotic assemblies and turning client GD&T specifications into production-ready tooling models.
Programmed and operated a DMG MORI 5-axis CNC machine to manufacture custom performance wheels, writing and optimizing G-code for cycle time and surface finish.
Built MATLAB Simscape simulations of EV3 robots so students could perform robotics tasks virtually during COVID-19, validating the robot body with FEA stress analysis and topology optimization.
